about_the_game:
This Bundle Contains:
  • Tier VI Premium KV-2 (R) heavy tank with special 3D style “Valhallan Ragnarok” with a garage slot and a crew
  • The Mordian style set for the BDR G1 B
  • 7 days of Premium Account
  • 30 tokens with x5 XP for KV-2(R)

Bundle Description:
In honor of Warhammer Skulls, Warhammer 40,000-themed content is now available in World of Tanks. Don’t miss your chance to get a truly terrifying Tier VI Premium heavy tank, the KV-2 (R) Valhallan Ragnarok and the Mordian style set for BDR G1 B!

NOTE: This DLC is only available until May 29, 2025.

The KV-2 (R): At a Glance
Firepower: The 152 mm howitzer will do lots of damage to any and all tanks in its path, regardless of tier, with its HE shells. Hunt big game like Tier VIII tanks or cripple Tier V ones!
Protection: Although not particularly thick, the KV-2 (R) armor is perfect for side scraping. Make sure your front plates are protected and you are good to go into firefight.
Speed: Although it won’t offer much in terms of acceleration, the KV-2 (R) can hit 35 km/h if given enough time on flat ground, or when going downhill.

DLC can be added to your World of Tanks account only once.
Items will be credited to the first account you log in to the game with.
